blocks.content: A contact point is the destination where Grafana sends notifications when an alert fires. For your first rule, you will use the default notification policy and select an existing contact point.
To select a contact point, complete the following steps:

In the **Configure notifications** section, leave **Use default policy** selected.

The default policy sends all alerts to the contact point you choose here. This is the simplest setup for getting started.

Select a contact point from the dropdown.

If a default contact point already exists (such as a default email), you can keep it. If you need a different destination, select another contact point from the list.

| Contact point type | When to use |
|--------------------|-------------|
| Email | Quick setup, good for testing |
| Slack | Team channels for collaborative response |
| PagerDuty | On-call rotation and escalation |

Skip the advanced options for now:

- **Override grouping**: Keep defaults
- **Override timings**: Keep defaults

You will learn about custom routing in the **Notification routing** learning path.
In the next milestone, you will save the rule and verify it appears in the rules list.
